wholePhysicalScope: The native stadium envelope contains 154 perimeter vertices. A separate mapped pitch ring provides the alignment and dimensions for the open bowl.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the sixteen scalloped roof shells, glazed outer ring and open bowl. Close levels add stepped seating, lanes, seams and field markings.
limitations: Roof seam paths, lower facade articulation, modern cladding colors, stand sections and track dimensions are estimates. The pitch orientation and perimeter are mapped.

The roofed stands cover an open field and running track. The original Copernicus surface has roof imprint around the stadium and can obscure its lower interior in the unmasked terrain view. Field height and foundation grade are approximate.
